rules.mono: Used for IP addresses, phone numbers, DNI, and [REDACTED] badges

spacing_and_layout.grid_rules: All panels must have h-full to align bottom edges. Utilize border-collapse style layouts where possible to save space.

gdpr_panel.special_effect: Subtle inset shadow, resembles a secure terminal

buttons.primary: bg-[#0055FF] text-white rounded-sm px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#3377FF] font-semibold text-sm transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A2542] text-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#212E4E] rounded-sm px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#212E4E] transition-all

inputs.textarea: bg-[#0B1120] border border-[#212E4E] text-[#F8FAFC] p-3 text-sm focus:border-[#0055FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0055FF] rounded-sm resize-none
inputs.search: Similar to textarea but single line, with Lucide Search icon

incident_cards.base: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 bg-[#1A2542] border border-[#212E4E] rounded-sm cursor-pointer hover:border-[#0055FF] transition-all text-center

checklist_item.container: flex items-center justify-between p-2 border-b border-[#212E4E] last:border-0

gdpr_badge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono bg-violet-500/20 text-violet-400 border border-violet-500/30

login.layout: Split screen or centered card with heavy glassmorphism over NOC background.

main_content.top_section: Incident Grid (8 cards: Sin datos móviles, APN, Roaming, Fibra caída, Router, Portabilidad, Microcortes, Velocidad lenta)
main_content.middle_section: Split view: Left (Chat/Free-text input for AI), Right (Guided Diagnostic Checklist)
main_content.bottom_section: Split view: Left (AI Suggestions Output), Right (GDPR Anonymization Preview + Generate Ticket)

login_background.description: Blue fiber optic cables connected to server, NOC vibe

testing_instructions.attributes: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='incident-card-apn', data-testid='login-button', data-testid='generate-ticket-btn')
